name: 993 hollow Ti64 intake valve, F0 LPBF concept
description: Independent concept of a hollow Ti-6Al-4V intake valve with four internal ribs and an open axial bore for depowdering. Only the head diameter, stem diameter, product envelope, declared mass and part number are published; all functional geometry remains an F0 hypothesis.

classification.intended_use: CAD, DfAM, mass, harmonic kinematics, axial load, buckling, natural mode and thermal screening; no manufacturing, installation or engine start-up authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no Porsche/FVD/Swindon photograph, surface or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: FVD - declared 993 intake valve dimensions
sources.notes: Declares a 49 mm head, 8 mm stem, 120 g mass, 50 x 110 x 50 mm envelope and part number 99310540902. No profile, material, treatment or tolerance. See SRC-FVD-993-INLET-VALVE-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - titanium valve context for the 993 engine
sources.notes: Identifies titanium valves in the Swindon four-valve system; proves neither a grade, nor a shape, nor compatibility with the two-valve M64 valve. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TITANIUM-VALVE-CONTEXT.

sources.title: EOS Titanium Ti64 Grade 5
sources.notes: Provides typical LPBF properties that depend on machine, orientation and treatment; no valve validation. See SRC-EOS-TI64-GRADE5.

sources.title: TIMETAL 6-4 physical properties
sources.notes: Wrought density, modulus, expansion, conductivity and specific heat are used for physical screening only. See SRC-TIMET-TI64-PHYSICAL-PROPERTIES.

sources.title: elferclassic - 993 Turbo technical data
sources.notes: The 6,720 rpm limiter provides only a documentary speed bound; the cam law, spring, pressures and temperatures remain synthetic. See SRC-ELFERCLASSIC-993-TURBO-TECHNICAL-DATA.

material.grade: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 LPBF, screening; material of the 993 part number and of the Swindon kit not published
material.standard: ASTM F2924 and a program-specific valve specification to be contracted

post_processing: vertical-axis orientation and support strategy to be qualified
documented depowdering of the cavity through the open axial bore
stress relief and heat treatment qualified for the machine and parameters
HIP to be decided on the defect population and representative fatigue
closure of the end by a process to be defined, then CT and proof test
machining and finishing of the stem, seat, groove, head and datums
coating, tip hardness, guide-seat matching and clearance balancing
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling
oriented coupons with tensile, HCF/LCF, impact, creep, oxidation, wear and alpha case at temperature
proof of depowdering of the 5 mm bore over about 100 mm and an internal cleanliness criterion
qualification of the end closure, its sealing and its retention
full CT, metallography, penetrant testing and metrology after all post-processing
full-scale valve tests on a hot rig, a motored cylinder head, then an engine before the vehicle

titanium.alloy: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 candidate only; no grade is established for Porsche part number 99310540902
titanium.heat_treatment: EOS stress-relief and ductility treatment to be qualified; no recipe frozen without machine, orientation, coupons and closure
machined_surfaces: stem diameter, straightness and surface finish
inspection: CT of the head, ribs, bore, closure and transitions
metrology of length, diameter, straightness, runout, seat and groove
roughness, porosity, alpha case, residual stresses and internal cleanliness
penetrant testing after machining and inspection of the closure
hot impact, bounce, wear, fatigue and retention tests
titanium.galvanic_isolation: Qualify titanium pairings with guide, seat, spring, keepers and retainer, fretting, galling, coatings, oil, combustion products and differential expansion.

known_limits: The 49 mm, 8 mm, 50 x 110 x 50 mm, 120 g and the part number come from a commercial product page with no drawing or independent measurement.
The 109 mm length, the head, neck, cavity, 5 mm bore and four 1.2 mm ribs are entirely synthetic.
The 55.45 g CAD mass and the 23.38% saving compare two F0 designs sharing the same invented exterior; they do not validate a saving over OEM.
The 12 mm lift, 240 crank degrees, 520 N + 40 N/mm spring, 0.20 MPa and +400 K are unmeasured regression cases.
The first mode at 190.8 Hz is a cantilever beam screen, not a modal analysis of the guide-seat-spring-cam system.
The section, Euler and circular plate stresses ignore contacts, impact, valve float, groove, defects and multiaxial fatigue.
The EOS/TIMET values are ambient and physical comparisons, not hot LPBF valve allowables.
The STEP proves only a readable BREP with an open cavity; it is authorized neither for manufacturing, nor for installation, nor for an engine.
